title: Kararlar
canDo: Gerçekçi gelecek durumların sonuçlarını first conditional ile anlatabilir, para ve alışveriş kararları hakkında konuşabilir, when / unless / as soon as ile koşul ve zaman bildirebilirim.
grammar: as soon as / until / before / after (gelecek)
koşul cümlelerinde may / might / could / imperative

liveClass.title: Ne yapacaksın?
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler küçük gruplarda bir aylık sınırlı bir bütçeyle karar vermeleri gereken senaryolar alır (yeni telefon mu, tatil mi, birikim mi). learn.explanation:
**First conditional**, gelecekte **gerçekleşmesi mümkün** bir durumu ve onun **olası sonucunu** anlatır.

| If + **present simple** | , **will** + fiil |
|---|---|
| If it **rains**, | I**'ll stay** at home. |
| If you **buy** it today, | you**'ll get** a free case. |
| If I **don't save**, | I **won't have** enough money. |

**Sıra değişebilir.** Sonuç başta gelirse virgül kullanılmaz:

- I**'ll stay** at home **if** it **rains**.

**Soru:** What **will** you **do if** they **don't give** you a refund?

**Önemli:** if'li kısımda **will kullanılmaz**:

- **If** it **rains** tomorrow... (~~If it will rain~~)

examples.en: If we leave now, we'll catch the bus.
You'll feel better if you get some sleep.
What will you do if you don't get the job?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "Yarın yağmur yağarsa" derken -ar/-er eki geleceği de kapsar; bu yüzden Türkçe konuşanlar sık sık "If it will rain tomorrow" der. İngilizcede if'ten sonra gelecek anlamı için de present simple kullanılır: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay at home.

options: If it will rain, I'll stay home.

lessons.title: Para konuşmaları
lessons.goal: Para ödünç alma, borç, tasarruf ve bütçe hakkında konuşabilirim.

discover.title: Öğrenci bütçesi: 5 altın kural
discover.body:
1. Make a budget. If you know how much you spend on food, transport and fun every month, you'll find it easier to save.

2. Don't borrow money from friends unless it's an emergency. If you borrow, pay it back quickly.

3. Cook at home. If you eat out every day, you'll waste hundreds every month.

4. Always ask about student discounts. Many cinemas, museums and shops offer them.

5. Before you buy something expensive, wait 48 hours. If you still want it after two days, it's probably worth it.

questions.prompt: According to the text, when is it OK to borrow from friends?
What should you do before buying something expensive?

learn.explanation:
**borrow mu lend mi?**

| Fiil | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **borrow** (from) | ödünç **almak** | Can I **borrow** your pen? / I borrowed money **from** my sister. |
| **lend** (to) | ödünç **vermek** | Can you **lend** me your pen? / She lent money **to** me. |
| **owe** | borçlu olmak | I **owe** you 20 lira. |
| **pay back** | geri ödemek | I'll **pay** you **back** on Friday. |

**spend / waste / save:**

- **spend** money **on** something: I spend a lot **on** clothes.
- **waste** money **on** something: Don't waste money **on** junk food.
- **save** (up) **for** something: I'm saving **for** a new laptop.

**afford:**

- I **can't afford** a new car. / I **can't afford to** go on holiday.

**First conditional + imperative:** Tavsiyede sonuç kısmında emir kipi kullanılabilir.

- **If** you borrow money, **pay** it back quickly.

learn.explanation:
**unless = if ... not** (-medikçe, -mezse)

| unless | if ... not |
|---|---|
| I won't go **unless** you come. | I won't go **if** you **don't** come. |
| **Unless** we leave now, we'll be late. | **If** we **don't** leave now, we'll be late. |

unless'tan sonra fiil **olumlu** kalır (anlam zaten olumsuz):

- **Unless** it **rains**... (~~Unless it doesn't rain~~)

**if mi when mi?**

| if | when |
|---|---|
| **Belki** olur, belki olmaz. | **Kesin** olacak, zamanı belli. |
| **If** I see Ali, I'll tell him. (Görebilirim, görmeyebilirim.) | **When** I see Ali, I'll tell him. (Görüşeceğiz.) |
| **If** I get the job, I'll celebrate. | **When** I get home, I'll call you. |

İkisinden sonra da **present simple** kullanılır.

examples.en: You won't get a refund unless you have the receipt.
When I get paid, I'll pay you back.
If I have time, I'll help you.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "-ince" (when) ve "-se" (if) farklı eklerdir; bu farkı İngilizcede de koruyun. "When I will get home" yanlıştır, doğrusu "When I get home". unless cümlesine ayrıca "not" eklemeyin; çift olumsuz olur.

lessons.title: Olur olmaz

discover.title: İade süreci
discover.body:
How to return an item to OnlineShop:

As soon as you receive your order, check that everything is OK.

If you want to return something, keep it in its original box until you send it back.

Before you post it, print the return label from your account.

After we receive the item, we'll check it. As soon as we've checked it, we'll send you an email.

You won't get your refund until we confirm the return. Most refunds take 5 to 7 days.

learn.explanation:
Geleceği anlatırken şu bağlaçlardan sonra da **present simple** kullanılır (will değil):

| Bağlaç | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **as soon as** | -ir -mez | I'll call you **as soon as** I **arrive**. |
| **until** | -e kadar | I'll wait here **until** you **come** back. |
| **before** | -meden önce | **Before** you **leave**, turn off the lights. |
| **after** | -dikten sonra | **After** I **finish** work, I'll go shopping. |
| **when** | -ince | **When** she **calls**, I'll tell her. |

**Bitmiş olmayı vurgulamak için present perfect** de kullanılabilir:

- I'll call you **as soon as** I**'ve finished**. (Bitirir bitirmez)

**not ... until:** -meden ... -me / -e kadar ... yok

- I **won't** decide **until** I**'ve seen** all the options. (Bütün seçenekleri görmeden karar vermeyeceğim.)

examples.en: As soon as the shop opens, I'll go in.
Don't pay until you've checked the price.
We'll have dinner after the film finishes.
examples.tr: Film bittikten sonra akşam yemeği yiyeceğiz.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "varır varmaz", "gelene kadar" gibi eklerde gelecek anlamı vardır, ama İngilizcede bu bağlaçlardan sonra will kullanılmaz. "I'll call you as soon as I will arrive" yanlış, "as soon as I arrive" doğru.

options: I'll call you as soon as I will arrive.
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

lessons.goal: Bir alışveriş kararının artılarını ve eksilerini tartışıp gerekçeli bir karar verebilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Seçenekleri tartmak:**

- **On the one hand**, ... **On the other hand**, ...
- The **advantage / disadvantage** of ... is that ...
- **The main problem is** ...
- It's expensive, **but it's worth it**.

**Sonuçları first conditional ile düşünmek** (ana cümlede will dışında modal da olur):

| Yapı | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| If ..., **will** | kesin sonuç | If I buy a car, I**'ll** have to pay for parking. |
| If ..., **might / may** | olası sonuç | If you wait, prices **might** go down. |
| If ..., **can** | olanak | If you don't like it, you **can** return it. |
| If ..., **should** | tavsiye | If you need it, you **should** buy it. |

**Karar vermek:**

- I **can't make up my mind**. / I'**ve decided to** ...
- I think I'**ll** go for the bike. (Anlık karar → will)
- **In the end**, ...

examples.en: If you wait until January, the prices might go down.
The main disadvantage is the price.
OK, I'll go for the cheaper one.

learn.turkishNote: "Karar veremiyorum" için "I can't give a decision" demeyin; doğal karşılığı "I can't make up my mind" ya da "I can't decide"dır. Anlık kararlar için will kullanılır: "OK, I'll take it!" (Tamam, alıyorum!)

task.prompt: Önünüzdeki bir kararı anlatan bir forum gönderisi yazın (100–130 kelime): örneğin yeni telefon mu tamir mi, kiralık mı satılık mı, tatil mi birikim mi. Artıları ve eksileri on the one hand / on the other hand ile yazın, first conditional (will, might, can) ve unless kullanın, sonunda kararınızı verin.
task.modelAnswer: I can't make up my mind about my holiday this summer. On the one hand, I've always wanted to visit Italy. If I go, I'll see Rome and Florence, and I'll practise my Italian. On the other hand, it's very expensive in August. If I spend that much, I won't be able to save for my new laptop. My friend says prices might go down if I travel in September, but I can't take time off then unless my boss agrees. So in the end, I've decided to stay in Turkey this summer and save my money. I'll go to Italy next spring when it's cheaper!

questions.prompt: Bir arkadaşınız ilk maaşını aldı ve ne yapacağını bilmiyor. Ona bir mesaj yazın (100–130 kelime): first conditional, unless, as soon as / before / when ve para kelimeleri (save, spend on, budget, afford, worth it) kullanarak tavsiyeler verin.
questions.modelAnswer: Congratulations on your first salary! Here's my advice. Before you spend anything, make a budget. If you know where your money goes, you'll save more easily. Try to save 20% as soon as you get paid. If you wait until the end of the month, there won't be anything left! Don't buy expensive clothes unless they're on sale, and don't borrow money unless it's an emergency. If you want a new phone, wait a few months. Prices might go down. But if you really want a good holiday, save for it. It's always worth it. When you get your next salary, you'll see the difference!
